Volcano Engine data agent DataAgent provides you with the ability of user research agent, which can mine client based characteristics and effectively identify users' true intentions and preferences based on in\-depth understanding of target users' behavior/portrait data, business domain knowledge, etc., assist business attribution analysis, output effective suggestion strategy. This article provides you with an overview of the capabilities description and operational guidance for the User Research Agent.

<span id="3afe7b37"></span>
# Capability overview

The user research agent is based on the data collection and behavior flow analysis capabilities of the Volcano Engine Growth Analysis DataFinder, providing you with sub\-agent capabilities such as AI behavior research and AI virtual research.

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

<span id="6907f6b6"></span>
# Application scenario

The user research agent can be used to analyze the behavior characteristics of a specific group of people, and is mainly suitable for business scenarios of finding characteristics, seeing paths, and digging clues for specific groups of people. Typical application scenarios in classic user behavior analysis scenarios and scenarios with strong dependency on behavior sequences are as follows.


|Classic user behavior analysis drill down scenario |Scenarios with strongly dependent behavior sequences |
|---|---|
|* **Functional effect evaluation and optimization (new function launch/AI innovation function incubation)** <br><br>   * In theory, users should use modules in a specific order, but the actual movement may not be as expected.<br><br>   * Is the user action forced or out of habit? Is it not clear whether the concatenation of functions and the order of operation are reasonable?<br><br>* **Activity effect optimization (fission/stimulation/card opening)** <br><br>   * The funnel is too large/small at a certain stage, and I want to quickly check the user's behavior before and after the activity to find out the reason for the abnormal funnel.<br><br>   * Users display the moving lines before and after the large referral program on the page, and deeply explore the reasons why users do not choose activity sharing.<br><br>* **Index change attribution (including experiments)** <br><br>   * During the hotspot outbreak period or before and after the launch of new functions, the indicators often increase or drop suddenly. After troubleshooting technical and event tracking failures, it is necessary to analyze the reasons from user behavior?<br><br>* **Analysis of anomalies in advertising behavior among different users (attribution of anomalous users)** <br><br>   * Analyze the differences in advertising behavior among users with different characteristics, find users with abnormal advertising behavior, analyze their behavioral characteristics and optimize them to recover revenue. |* **User intent analysis/algorithm optimization (search, recommendation, exit, etc.)** <br><br>   * What is the user's motivation for initiating a search? Especially when a search is initiated due to dissatisfaction with the vertical distribution of homepage videos.<br><br>* **New user landings (cold start analysis)** <br><br>   * The user is no longer active after the first activation, and there is no trace of resale activation. Does the user experience negative behavior on the first day of use?<br><br>* **Risk behavior analysis**<br><br>   * There may be risk points in the information such as the movement of the live streamer, the geographical location of the merchant, and the delivery and receipt?<br><br>   * Did the user engage in risk behaviors such as swiping orders and gray and black production?<br><br>* **Experience and performance problem discovery and attribution**<br><br>   * The common performance problems are found in the behavioral streaming data of large number of users' APP behaviors and performance indicators.<br><br>* **Customer complaint troubleshooting/attribution**<br><br>   * The team is working on an AI assistant and receiving feedback from users who are dissatisfied with the recommendation?<br><br>   * User feedback screen projection failure, abnormal playback and other problems? |


<span id="ffe46b46"></span>
# Precautions


* AI Behavior Research Function: Relies on Volcano Engine DataFinder products, and the function is currently in the beta version and is in the invitation testing stage. If you want to use this function, you need to purchase and activate the DataFinder product first, and contact the technical support staff to apply for the invitation testing permission.

   If you have applied for opening an invitation to test, and it still prompts that "AI group research" cannot be used when using it, please contact your project administrator to open the function permission.

* AI virtual research function: The current function is a beta version and is in the invitation testing stage. If you want to use this function, you need to contact the technical support staff to apply for permission for invitation testing.


<span id="48ff9ef9"></span>
# Operation guidance


* AI behavior research function: You need to collect and report user behavior data and user attribute data (user tags, portraits, etc.) to DataFinder according to the user behavior analysis goal, and then you can conduct in\-depth investigation of certain users, or conduct user group research. Activity details can be found here [AI Behavior Research](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/AI_Behavior_Research).

* AI virtual research function: You need to clarify the target user profile of the research based on the research objectives, and the AI virtual research technical support staff will generate a virtual research target group for you, and then create a research questionnaire to carry out virtual research. See activity details [AI Virtual Survey](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/undefined/69f06a6ac9abae0523370c91).
